subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt timestamped config backup names in core once the migration and collision blockers are fixed?
rationale: This is a user-visible config recovery behavior change, and config backup migration semantics can delete recovery points unless maintainers choose the compatibility contract explicitly.

options.title: Adopt after migration-safe fixes
options.body: Require the timestamped scheme to preserve or convert existing numbered backups, avoid collisions, update docs, and show real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the numbered ring
options.body: Close or pause timestamped naming work and keep the shipped `.bak.1` to `.bak.4` behavior as the stable recovery contract.

options.title: Defer to broader backup design
options.body: Track naming together with backup directory/count configurability in the broader backup-management issue instead of landing this narrower PR now.

recommendation.title: Adopt after migration-safe fixes
recommendation.body: Require the timestamped scheme to preserve or convert existing numbered backups, avoid collisions, update docs, and show real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent config compatibility and recovery-history signal among the likely owners.
